name: Homework Reader
description: Photograph handwritten homework. Claude writes it out exactly as written, then lists the mistakes and a corrected version.
uses: Sends the photos you choose to Claude, on your Claude account (uses your plan's usage).
Shows Claude's transcription and corrections on this page. Nothing is saved.

name: Word Quest
description: Write a sentence on paper and photograph it. Claude reads it, points out the mistakes, then plays out the story. English and Spanish.
uses: Sends the photos you choose to Claude, on your Claude account (uses your plan's usage).
Sends the sentence you wrote to Claude to decide what happens in the story, and may ask it for a fun reply to unplanned sentences.
Saves progress, stars and a log of sentences on this device only (browser storage). Nothing is uploaded by the app.
